title: FACILITY ALPHA DIRECTIVE
message: CLARK PROTOCOL INITIATED: The ancient spell-forge below the citadel was not built by the dwarves. It is a containment engine for an extraplanar entity known as Leviathan-IX. Do not break the runic seal.

title: AIRSHIP NAVIGATION LOGS
message: Coordinates recovered for floating sky-fortress ruins: 45°12'N, 12°88'E. The primary elemental crystal powering the hull is depleted. Defense golems remain hostile.

title: XANATHAR CARTEL TRANSMISSION
message: Vault passcode fragment recovered: 4 - 8 - 15 - 16 - 23 - 42. Beware the illusion traps guarding the vault room door.
